# Python input authoring

Python input helpers return serializable View objects, rather than DOM widgets or MosaicClient instances. The bind argument serializes as as, source serializes as from, and other keyword names use camel case. Options whose value is None are omitted before aliases are applied; for example menu(bind=selection, as_=None) retains the bind argument. False, zero and empty strings remain present. Unknown keyword options are retained for custom clients.

## input

`vg.input(kind: str, **opts: Any) -> View`

Create a view for any input kind without registering a parser extension.

## option

`vg.option(label: Any, value: Any = omitted) -> dict[str, Any]`

Create a label/value option; an omitted value uses its label, while explicit None remains None.

Python option(label) uses the label as its value; option(label, None) keeps an explicit null value. In a mixed options list containing a dictionary, Python converts every non-dictionary entry into a label/value dictionary. An all-scalar list remains scalar. The JavaScript menu client treats each scalar option as a value and each object as an option record.

## select

`vg.select(label: str, bind: Any, options: Any, multiple: bool = False, value: Any = None, **opts: Any)`

Create a Python authoring extension view for a select input.

## checkbox

`vg.checkbox(label: str, bind: Any, value: bool = False, **opts: Any)`

Create a Python authoring extension view for a checkbox input.


Python select and checkbox are authoring extensions. The default declarative parser recognizes menu, search, slider and table only. To consume select, checkbox or a custom input, register the name with inputNames and provide a corresponding JavaScript API implementation. Serializing a Python extension does not add a built-in browser widget.

<a :href="withBase('/templates/inputs/basic/python-extensions.py')" download>Download the Python-only extension examples</a>. These examples demonstrate serialized authoring behavior; they have no default JSON/YAML or JavaScript runtime equivalent.
